title: Implement to_roman and from_roman
description: Create roman.py with to_roman(n) (1..3999 -> canonical Roman numeral, e.g. 1994 -> 'MCMXCIV') and from_roman(s) (inverse). Raise ValueError for out-of-range integers and for malformed numerals such as 'IIII', 'VX' or ''. from_roman(to_roman(n)) must equal n for every n in range.
